title: Gold Medal Top N Pop Popcorn 50 lb. Bagged

reviews.title: Fluffy and crisp!
reviews.body: I just couldn't wait, as soon as this arrived today I made a batch. Wow, this is a really nice, large butterfly popcorn. The texture is fluffy and crisp, tastes great, popped well, almost every seed popped! It's a great value as this sack was $20 cheaper than my usual brand. It functioned exactly as advertised. Thank you so much. Cheers!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 23, 2025
reviews.author: Serena-Rena-Bo-Beena--Bana-Fana-Fo-Feena--Fe-Fi-Mo-Meena--Serena!

reviews.title: Great popcorn, excellent customer service
reviews.body: I had delivery issues with this popcorn and reported it to Amazon. Based on delivery feedback, I'm guessing the bag broke in the shipping facility. Helen from the third party warehouse was amazing. She got my order replaced and it was shipped immediately. Popcorn tastes great too!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 1, 2026
reviews.author: Chloe M

reviews.title: Great price, best popcorn!
reviews.body: Good popcorn. Great price with delivery.I pop around 50 pounds of popcorn every year to use as bear bait and have used about every brand out there.I often use the left overs to pop in my air popper for me and my dogs. I pop it into a 10 liter pot and usually get 8-9 liters from two 1/2 cup batches.  But this year my pot wasn’t big enough!  This popcorn overflowed the pot. Incredibly large butterfly flakes.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 22, 2025
reviews.author: masonj

reviews.title: Pops a lot
